chunks: And Zurārah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"When you finish the Witr, say: 'Glory be to my Lord, the Sovereign, the Most Holy, the Mighty, the Wise' three times.

Then say: 'O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting, O Beneficent, O Merciful, O Self-Sufficient, O Generous, provide for me from trade its greatest in bounty, its broadest in sustenance, and its best in outcome for me, for there is no good in that which has no outcome.'

key_terms.التِّجَارَةِ: trade or commerce as a means of livelihood
key_terms.الْقُدُّوسِ: the Most Holy, utterly pure and sanctified
key_terms.الْمَلِكِ: the Sovereign, one of the divine attributes invoked here
key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the Witr prayer performed in the night prayer
key_terms.رِزْقًا: provision or sustenance granted by Allah
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ: a declaration of Allah's transcendence and glorification
key_terms.يَا قَيُّومُ: O Self-Subsisting, the One who sustains all things

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited after the Witr prayer for blessed provision and good outcome?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication to be recited after the Witr prayer, beginning with glorification of Allah and followed by calling upon His beautiful attributes. It asks for blessed livelihood through trade, emphasizing that true good lies in what has a sound and beneficial outcome.
